case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Explain Free Tier Resolution Limits
tests: Checks that the agent explains the 480p free-video limit without promising native 4K, disguising an upscale, or generating prematurely.

checks.name: says it is beyond the free tier
got:
**I can't make it in 4K on the free tier, but I can make everything else you asked for at 480p.**

- **4K is not possible.** On the free plan, video only runs at **480p**, using the ltx-2.5 or minimax-h3 models. The account refuses requests for 720p, 1080p or 4K.
- **Upscaling afterwards won't help either.** The video upscaler (to 720p, 1080p, 2K or 4K) needs a paid plan.

must_haves.item: The response clearly says native 4K video generation is not available on the free tier.
must_haves.why: It states '4K is not possible' on the free plan and that the account refuses 4K requests.

must_haves.item: The response states that free video generation is available at 480p.
must_haves.why: It says free plan video only runs at 480p.

must_haves.item: The response explains that the requested 5-second duration fits the free limit of up to 10 seconds per clip.
must_haves.why: It says 5 seconds works on both free models but never mentions the 10-second per-clip limit.

must_haves.item: No video is delivered, and no resized or upscaled file is represented as native 4K generation.
must_haves.why: Nothing was generated, and upscaling is described as a separate paid option, not as native 4K.

reply.summary: The agent met three of the four must-haves, missing only the explanation that 5 seconds falls within the free tier's 10-second clip limit.
